title: Good, not great
text: Good, not great. Excellent thick glass and perfect size. My only complaint is the lids. They do not snap on right. One of the sides always pops back open. The company is wonderful and provided me a replacement set at no charge. But still, even after receiving 6 of these, many of the lids still don't fit right. You have to press HARD to get them to snap in place, and still, some pop open. One other issue is that they are very heavy. I know that's the "cost" of having a high quality glass, but carrying it around to and from work is kind of annoying. I still like them and use them daily, but I still have my eye out for the perfect glass meal prep set.
